records.title: CLIP-DPO: Vision-Language Models as a Source of Preference for Fixing Hallucinations in LVLMs
records.reason: 一次資料の要旨・本文が示す対象はLLM推論システムの計算量、メモリ、レイテンシ、スループット、KV cache、量子化、offload、servingの改善と技術的につながらない。CLIP-DPO applies preference optimization to improve visual-language model hallucination behavior. The contribution is training-time alignment and evaluation on hallucination benchmarks; no inference efficiency or offload method is presented.

records.title: A Review of Multi-Modal Large Language and Vision Models
records.reason: 本文を確認したが、対象系統との接続またはLLM推論効率の実証が弱く、一般化可能性を確認できない。The survey reviews multimodal LLM and vision models, including broad architecture/application coverage. It does not give a focused inference optimization method or controlled systems evaluation; retain only as weak background for the linked deployment/efficiency topic.

records.title: Universal Cross-Tokenizer Distillation via Approximate Likelihood Matching
records.reason: 本文を確認したが、対象系統との接続またはLLM推論効率の実証が弱く、一般化可能性を確認できない。Universal Cross-Tokenizer Distillation transfers across tokenizer vocabularies and evaluates downstream transfer quality. It does not measure decode throughput, latency, or serving memory, so only a weak tokenization/efficiency connection remains.

records.title: Towards Scalable and Stable Parallelization of Nonlinear RNNs
records.reason: 本文を確認したが、対象系統との接続またはLLM推論効率の実証が弱く、一般化可能性を確認できない。The paper parallelizes nonlinear RNN evaluation using quasi-Newton methods. Sequence experiments include a case where quasi-ELK takes 221 ms versus 96 ms sequentially; this is architecture-specific and does not show a speedup for transformer/LLM inference.
